summary.fine_unchecked: Fine so far, but Fettle couldn't read the disks' health.
summary.fine_partial: Fine so far, but Fettle couldn't check everything.
summary.action.deep_check: Run a Deep check to read the disks' health.
summary.partial: Fettle couldn't check much on this PC.
check.failed: Windows didn't answer when Fettle asked.
check.needs_admin.action: Run a Deep check to see it.
storage.disk_fine_no_wear: {model} looks healthy, but it doesn't report its wear.
storage.ssd_wearing.action: It still works, but back up anything important and plan a replacement in the next year or so.
storage.ssd_worn: {model} has reached the end of its rated life.
storage.ssd_worn.action: Back up anything important now and plan to replace this drive soon.
storage.nvme_critical: {model} is reporting a problem with itself.
storage.nvme_critical.action: Back up anything important now. The drive's own health check says it's at risk.
storage.media_errors: {model} has had {count} read or write errors.
storage.media_errors_one: {model} has had 1 read or write error.
storage.media_errors.action: Keep your backups current and run Fettle again in a month to see if the number grows.
storage.pending_sectors: {model} has {count} sectors it's struggling to read.
storage.pending_sectors_one: {model} has 1 sector it's struggling to read.
storage.pending_sectors.action: Back up anything important now. A drive in this state can get worse quickly.
storage.uncorrectable_sectors: {model} found {count} sectors it can't read or repair.
storage.uncorrectable_sectors_one: {model} found 1 sector it can't read or repair.
storage.reallocated_sectors.action: Keep your backups current and run Fettle again in a month to see if the number grows.
storage.disk_hot.action: Check the PC's fans and airflow, and keep the vents clear.
storage.deep_check: Fettle can't read {model}'s health without administrator access.
storage.deep_check.action: Run a Deep check to see it.
storage.no_health: {model} doesn't share its health with Windows.
storage.usb_not_checked: {model} is a USB drive. Fettle only checks the drives inside this PC.
storage.low_space.action: Free up some space: empty the Recycle Bin, or move big files somewhere else.
battery.fine: Your battery holds {pct}% of the capacity it had when new.
battery.worn: Your battery holds {pct}% of the capacity it had when new, so expect less runtime than it used to give.
battery.worn.action: Replace the battery to get the runtime back.
battery.unknown: The battery didn't report its original capacity.
memory.single_channel: There's only one memory stick, so it runs in single-channel mode. A matching second stick could help in games.
windows.ending_feature_update: This version of {product} only gets security updates until {until}.
windows.ending_feature_update.action: Install the latest Windows 11 update from Windows Update before then. It's free.
windows.ending_esu.action: Before then, enrol in Extended Security Updates from Windows Update, or upgrade to Windows 11.
windows.ending.action: Upgrade to a supported version of Windows before then to keep getting security fixes.
windows.unsupported.action: Upgrade to a supported version of Windows to keep getting security fixes.
windows.unsupported_feature_update: This version of {product} no longer gets security updates.
windows.unsupported_feature_update.actio: Install the latest Windows 11 update from Windows Update. It's free.
windows.unsupported_esu.action: Enrol in Extended Security Updates from Windows Update, or upgrade to Windows 11.
windows.esu_enrolled_until: {product} gets security updates until {until} through Extended Security Updates.
windows.esu_enrolled: {product} gets security updates through Extended Security Updates.
windows.esu_ending: {product} only gets Extended Security Updates until {until}.
windows.esu_ending.action: Upgrade to Windows 11 before then to keep getting security fixes.
windows.esu_unknown: {product} only gets security updates if it's enrolled in Extended Security Updates.
windows.esu_unknown.action: Open Windows Update to check whether this PC is enrolled.
windows.esu_stale: {product} has missed the security updates released since November 2025.
windows.esu_stale.action: Enrol in Extended Security Updates from Windows Update and install what it offers, or upgrade to Windows 11.
windows.esu_stale_enrolled.action: Open Windows Update and install what it offers.
windows.esu_commercial.action: Ask whoever manages this PC about Extended Security Updates, or upgrade to Windows 11.
windows.unknown_version: Fettle doesn't know the support dates for this version of {product} yet.
windows.restart_nudge: Your PC hasn't restarted in {days} days. A restart lets updates finish installing.
windows.cpu_ready: This processor is on Microsoft's list for Windows 11.
windows.cpu_unsupported: This processor isn't on Microsoft's list for Windows 11, so Windows Update won't offer the upgrade.
windows.cpu_unknown: Fettle couldn't tell whether this processor is on Microsoft's list for Windows 11.
windows.cpu_unsupported_w11: This processor isn't on Microsoft's list for Windows 11. Windows runs, but Microsoft doesn't promise updates on PCs like this.
windows.tpm_unknown: Fettle couldn't check the TPM security chip.
windows.no_tpm: No TPM security chip found. Windows 11 needs TPM 2.0; most processors from the last few years have one built in that can be turned on in the BIOS (fTPM or PTT).
windows.tpm_ready: TPM 2.0 is present, as Windows 11 requires.
windows.tpm_old: The TPM is older than version 2.0, which Windows 11 requires.
windows.secure_boot_on: Secure Boot is on, so this PC supports it, as Windows 11 requires.
windows.secure_boot_off: Secure Boot is off. Windows 11 only needs a PC that supports it, but turning it on in the BIOS adds protection.
windows.secure_boot_off_w11: Secure Boot is off. Turning it on in the BIOS helps block malware that starts before Windows, and some games need it.
startup.many: {count} apps start with Windows, which can slow down startup.
startup.many.action: Turn off the ones you don't need in Task Manager, under Startup apps.
graphics.couldnt_check: Fettle couldn't check the graphics card.
graphics.old_driver: The driver for {name} dates from {date}. A newer one may improve performance and fix bugs.
